title: Maybe Someday
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: After a betrayal costs her both her boyfriend and her home, a young woman is drawn to her neighbour, a gifted guitarist who needs a lyricist. As they write songs together, their bond grows despite obstacles.
readIf: you like music-centred romance and an emotionally honest love story with a slow build.
skipIf: you dislike stories that centre on cheating or a relationship that begins while others are involved.

pairings.reason: A quieter literary novel in which music and love are tangled with loss.
Another music story where creative partnership and love blur together, told on a bigger canvas.
A couple connects through shared music and a slow-growing trust.
